custom_rules.name: email_domain_whitelist
custom_rules.description: Validates that email domains are from approved providers

custom_rules.name: payment_method_by_country
custom_rules.description: Validates that certain payment methods are only used in supported countries

custom_rules.name: premium_user_validation
custom_rules.description: Validates that premium users have valid payment methods
custom_rules.expression: NOT (subscription_tier = 'premium' AND (payment_method IS NULL OR payment_method = ''))

custom_rules.name: transaction_amount_by_tier
custom_rules.description: Validates that transaction amounts are appropriate for user subscription tier
custom_rules.expression: NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transactions t JOIN users u ON t.customer_id = u.id WHERE u.subscription_tier = 'basic' AND t.amount > 500.00)

custom_rules.name: recent_login_check
custom_rules.description: Validates that active users have logged in within the last 90 days

custom_rules.name: transaction_frequency_check
custom_rules.description: Validates that users don't have too many transactions in a short period (potential fraud)
